mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power, leading to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-pandemic recovery phase, a rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 260 signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the post-pandemic recovery phase, when CPIAUCSL exceeds 260, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity that boosts corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO remains above 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500.0 thousand units signals weakening housing market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 1500.0, SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and manufacturing employment (PAYEMS) indicate a broad-based industrial slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and PAYEMS fails to produce negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a high level of retail sales (RSAFS) above 550,000 million dollars signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion, when RSAFS exceeds 550000, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.
